tags.feature: Online Duels can now be enjoyed in Yu-Gi-Oh! Dungeon Dice Monsters as part of the Yu-Gi-Oh! EARLY DAYS COLLECTION!
With this update, there are now three classic titles capable of playing online with Duelists from around the world.
- Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters 4: Battle of Great Duelists
Download and install this free update before booting up the game to enjoy online play for all three of these titles.

notes.title: Multiplayer Update – Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship Tournament 2004
notes.content:
[b]As part of patch 1.2.0 you’ll be able to take your retro gaming to new heights as you challenge players from across the world and prove you are truly a Dueling world champion in Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship Tournament 2004! 

Now you can Duel online in two of the titles available in Yu-Gi-Oh! EARLY DAYS COLLECTION;
 Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters 4: Battle of Great Duelists and Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship Tournament 2004.  

Be sure to download and install this free update before booting up the game to enjoy the additional online play. [/b]

notes.title: "Yu-Gi-Oh! EARLY DAYS COLLECTION" is available now!
notes.content:
[h3]14 masterpieces from the history of Yu-Gi-Oh! video games are back!
"Yu-Gi-Oh! EARLY DAYS COLLECTION" containing 14 pieces of Yu-Gi-Oh! video game history is now available!
Please take this opportunity to travel back in time to the Duel of that day.

[previewyoutube=2gHXgpnMexY;full][/previewyoutube]
 
[b]Titles[/b]
1. Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters
2. Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters II: Dark Duel Stories
3. Yu-Gi-Oh! Monster Capsule
4. Yu-Gi-Oh! Dark Duel Stories
5. Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters 4: Battle of Great Duelists
6. Yu-Gi-Oh! Dungeon Dice Monsters
7. Yu-Gi-Oh! The Eternal Duelist Soul
8. Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters 6: Expert 2
9. Yu-Gi-Oh! The Sacred Cards
10. Yu-Gi-Oh! Reshef of Destruction
11. Yu-Gi-Oh! Worldwide Edition: Stairway to the Destined Duel
12. Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship Tournament 2004
13. Yu-Gi-Oh! Destiny Board Traveler
14. Yu-Gi-Oh! 7 Trials to Glory: World Championship Tournament 2005 (Yu-Gi-Oh! Day of the Duelist: World Championship Tournament 2005)
[/h3]
